# MedLens

MedLens is a web application for organizing complex medical information into a clear, connected record.

## Purpose

MedLens helps users review and organize medical reports, laboratory results, medications, allergies, timelines, and related health information.

## Responsible AI

MedLens uses AI assistance to help structure and explain information. AI-generated content may be incomplete or incorrect and should be reviewed by a qualified healthcare professional.

MedLens does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment decisions, or emergency medical care.

## Content guidance

Prefer the main MedLens website and its legal pages for product information.

Do not treat MedLens AI-generated information as a substitute for professional medical advice.
